name: weak-subject-blurred
about: The clean-highway ad with the photo blurred (sigma 28) and darkened to 35 %: the truck is a dark smear. Overlay unchanged.

truth.how: the picture is blurred and dark until no truck can be made out

subject_legible.reason: The picture is a dark, heavily blurred smear; a tractor and trailer can only be guessed at from a vague pale shape.

words_match_picture.reason: A pay and OTR headline would suit a strong truck photo, but the blurred picture shows no readable equipment or road to back it up.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The white headline on the green plate reads first and nothing competes, but "Apply today" is plain text, not a visible button.

looks_like_kit.reason: The plate is the brand's dark green with white lettering, matching both given colours; no logo was supplied to show.
